description: ISEE, the statistics institute of New Caledonia, publishes census housing tables as Excel workbooks on its housing and household equipment page. The housing construction and comfort workbook, drawn from the 2009, 2014 and 2019 censuses, counts principal residences and their residents by commune and province, with district tables for Greater Nouméa. Its tables cover the construction period, the main material of walls, roof and floor, rooms and floor area, and electricity supply split into the general grid, generators and solar panels. Water supply tables separate piped water from individual or collective water points, and an equipment table counts indoor toilets, showers, air conditioning and solar water heaters. Not every table exists for every census; the title sheet marks which years each table covers. A companion workbook gives the dwelling stock by category and tenure, and another gives electricity network subscribers by commune. Coverage is territory-wide for New Caledonia. Format and access: free XLS downloads with no registration. Licence: the legal notice reserves all reproduction rights and requires permission for electronic reproduction. Caveats: labels are in French, and some 2019 cells read information not available. Simulation uses: building material and off-grid solar and generator shares by commune for cyclone exposure and electrification studies. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.
